## Addendum · one more row from the same run · 2026-11-03T02:30Z

⛔ Not a claim. Carried here from #29675 (closed not planned) because this card is the run's collecting card for checklist re-points.

| item | what is stale | re-point to |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `i18n.studio-follows-app-locale` acceptance[1] (the mixed-language clause) and negative[0] | They count `Account (Success Overlay)` on a zh-CN Studio as a mixed-language failure. That label is the showcase's code-shipped `objectExtensions` scalar (`examples/app-showcase/src/data/extensions/account.extension.ts`, the #8037 fixture), and the #8284 maintainer ruling (2026-08-13) plus ADR-0029 D9.2a make an explicit override win over the packaged catalog in every locale (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` `translateObject`; pins `i18n-resolver.test.ts` "a code-shipped extension's scalars beat the catalog", `packages/rest/src/meta-object-i18n-explicit-override.test.ts`). | The clause carries the exception: a label authored over the packaged one (a code extension scalar or a tenant rename) is served as authored in every locale, so `Account (Success Overlay)` in zh-CN Studio ticks. |

Measured live on `c9636f1e` (os-dev-report 6593898980 on #29675): `/meta/object/showcase_account` and the app bundle both answer `Account (Success Overlay)` under zh-CN; the sidebar's 客户 is the nav entry's own key `apps.showcase_app.navigation.nav_accounts.label`, not the object label.
